title: The warning shows on the Part Sale Matrix side too
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, with Separate Part Sale pricing on and one range from $0.00 on each side: Default on Margin % 40 on both sides, tier A on % Off 5 on the Work Order Matrix and % Off 95 on the Part Sale Matrix.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click the Part Sale Matrix tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • On the Work Order Matrix tab tier A's value reads 5% off.
  • It has no warning icon.

Step 3:

  • On the Part Sale Matrix tab tier A's 95% off shows the warning icon to its right.
  • The page offers no setting to turn the warning off.
